id: title:CShine612:open linked insights when monaco loads after the wait

observations.behavior: Resets pending state before waiting for Monaco, establishing a generation counter to distinguish newer URLs from older ones.
observations.posthog_connection: Addresses potential race conditions where delayed Monaco loading could cause URL parameters to be ignored or overwritten incorrectly.

observations.behavior: Checks cached generation ID against current one; only creates query tab if no newer URL replaced it after the timeout.
observations.posthog_connection: Preserves correct URL-to-query binding despite race between multiple URLs and late Monaco initialization.

observations.behavior: Adds assertions that an insight opens correctly even when Monaco loads significantly later than the initial URL handler execution.
observations.posthog_connection: Provides regression protection for shared SQL editor behavior regarding timing-dependent recovery of insights.

observations.limitations: Only frontend implementation and test hunks are provided. No backend compatibility checks, migration scripts, or complete end-to-end browser context are visible. Tests rely on fake timers rather than real async behavior.

review.limitations: Only frontend implementation and test hunks are provided. No backend compatibility checks, migration scripts, or complete end-to-end browser context are visible. Tests rely on fake timers rather than real async behavior.
review.reason: The change implements bounded correctness improvements to URL handling and Monaco readiness in the SQL editor with clear guard conditions and specific assertions. It does not demonstrate broader systemic risk reduction across components.
review.posthog_relevance: Relevant for users relying on shared SQL editor stability after page reloads or navigation, especially those using embedded editors or warehouse connections.
review.uncertainty: Assessment relies solely on provided hunks without complete context of other dependent modules.
